<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 180.0423, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈179.0350 Da. The formula that matches this mass within a few ppm is C₉H₇O₄ (exact mass 179.0344 Da, ~3 ppm error). No other hetero‑atoms are required to fit the observed mass.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H7O4</final_answer>
